2607.01977.title: OntoLearner: A Modular Python Library for Ontology Learning with Large Language Models
2607.01977.paper_summary: Ontology learning (OL) aims to automatically construct structured knowledge models from text, yet progress remains fragmented across methods, domains, and evaluation practices. Despite decades of research, OL lacks a shared infrastructure for systematic evaluation and ontology access. This absence has hindered progress and fragmented research, leaving the central challenges of OL largely unaddressed. We introduce OntoLearner, a modular, cross-domain, and first-of-its-kind framework that unifies ontology access, large language model (LLM)-driven learning pipelines, and standardized benchmarking. OntoLearner releases 180 machine-readable ontologies spanning 22 domains and provides pipeline-ready datasets with train/dev/test splits for three core OL tasks: term typing, taxonomy discovery, and non-taxonomic relation extraction. Using this infrastructure, we conduct a large-scale empirical study of OL, evaluating 22 retrieval models and 12 LLMs across domains and tasks. The results converge on a finding that reframes the central challenge of OL: failure modes scale with ontological complexity rather than model size or architectural sophistication. The primary bottleneck is not model capability, but a structural mismatch between how models encode knowledge and how ontologies organize it. These findings establish that effective OL is reachable through the cross-domain, multi-task benchmarking enabled by OntoLearner. OntoLearner is open-source (MIT license) at https://github.com/sciknoworg/OntoLearner/.
2607.01977.paper_summary_zh: 本體學習（OL）旨在自動從文本中構建結構化知識模型，但在方法、領域和評估實踐方面的進展仍然零散。儘管經歷了數十年的研究，OL 缺乏一個共享的基礎設施來進行系統評估和本體訪問。這一缺失阻礙了進展並使研究碎片化，導致 OL 的核心挑戰在很大程度上未得到解決。我們介紹了 OntoLearner，這是一個模組化、跨領域的首創框架，統一了本體訪問、大型語言模型（LLM）驅動的學習管道和標準化基準測試。OntoLearner 發布了 180 個可機器閱讀的本體，涵蓋 22 個領域，並提供了針對三個核心 OL 任務的管道準備數據集，這些任務包括術語類型標記、分類法發現和非分類法關係提取。利用這一基礎設施，我們對 OL 進行了一項大規模實證研究，評估了 22 個檢索模型和 12 個 LLM 在不同領域和任務中的表現。結果集中在一個重新框定 OL 中心挑戰的發現上：失敗模式與本體的複雜性成比例，而非模型的大小或架構的複雜性。主要瓶頸不在於模型能力，而在於模型編碼知識的方式與本體組織知識的方式之間的結構不匹配。這些發現確立了通過 OntoLearner 使跨領域、多任務基準測試成為可能的有效 OL 是可達成的。OntoLearner 是開源的（MIT 許可證），網址為 https://github.com/sciknoworg/OntoLearner/。
